'''''Valeriana eriocarpa''''' is a species of [[flowering plant]] in the family [[Caprifoliaceae]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Valerianella eriocarpa var. eriocarpa - Encyclopedia of Life|url=https://eol.org/pages/52472996|access-date=2022-02-04|website=eol.org}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Mifsud |first=Stephen |date=2002-08-23 |title=Valerianella eriocarpa (Hairy-fruited Cornsalad) : MaltaWildPlants.com - the online Flora of the Maltese Islands. |url=https://www.maltawildplants.com/CAPR/Valerianella_eriocarpa.php |access-date=2022-03-05 |website=www.maltawildplants.com |language=en-us |archive-date=2021-12-27 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211227195226/https://www.maltawildplants.com/CAPR/Valerianella_eriocarpa.php |url-status=dead }}</ref> It is an annual native to western and southern Europe, northwestern Turkey, and north Africa.<ref name = powo/>
